import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem sprint_development_0081 (a b c : ℤ) (hb : b > 0) (hc : c > 0) : a % b + a % c ≤ a % (b * c / gcd b c) := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem sprint_development_0081 (a b c : ℤ) (hb : b > 0) (hc : c > 0) : a % b + a % c ≤ a % (b * c / gcd b c) := by
  rw [Int.emod_eq_sub_self_emod]
  have : a % b = a - b * (a / b) := by ring
  have : a % c = a - c * (a / c) := by ring
  rw [this, this] at *
  have : a - b * (a / b) + a - c * (a / c) ≤ a - (b * (a / b) + c * (a / c)) := by linarith
  rw [Int.emod_eq_sub_self_emod] at this
  have : b * (a / b) + c * (a / c) = a / (b * c / gcd b c) := by ring
  rw [this] at this
  linarith
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0081 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0081 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0081

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0081
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0081
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
